# Copilot repository instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the selected repository revision before acting. It defines this repository's scope and review gates; this entry grants no additional authority. If it cannot be read, report the missing source and hold dependent edits.

Resolve the selected ref and actual HEAD; for a pull request, resolve the current base branch separately from its recorded base SHA. Keep work within the user-authorized scope and AGENTS.md. Models and agents are task-selected carriers, not permanent roles. Do not merge automatically; final merge approval remains with the user.

For meaning, placement, navigation, or lineage review, retain the source revision and the purpose for which it is current. Repository location, branch name, modification time, and a candidate proposal do not establish Native Current, Canon, or approval.

Keep saved settings, loaded instructions, checks, and receiver use distinct. Focus verification on affected scope while retaining required checks and regression coverage. A blocker holds only dependent actions. Report the outcome, material evidence, limits, and next step in clear Traditional Chinese without a forced template.
